intro: Ask and Suggest tags use Claude with your own Anthropic API key. Search by meaning runs on this computer. AI agents are apps on your computer that you let in.

ask.hint: Describe what you're after in plain words. Claude writes the search, and you see it before it runs.
ask.noKey: Ask needs your own Anthropic API key.

tags.hint: Claude suggests tags for many assets at once. Each one waits for you to accept or reject it.

meaning.title: Search by meaning
meaning.hint: Find images, 3D models, videos and fonts by describing what they show, in any language. Free, and nothing leaves this computer.

agents.hint: Let Claude Code, Claude Desktop or another MCP app search your library and, if you allow it, organize it.
agents.moved: Now in the AI view, with Undo.
